label: Bible Study
prompt: This beginning of _____ did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
verse: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
note: Water into wine at a wedding in Cana — the first of the signs in John's Gospel.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And thou shalt be secure, because there is _____; yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.
verse: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.
note: Zophar promises Job security 'because there is hope' — rest in safety, even after the worst.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his _____ fell off from his hands.
verse: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.
note: An angel woke Peter in prison with a smite on the side, and his chains simply fell off his hands.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For here have we no _____ city, but we seek one to come.
verse: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
note: Readers who'd lost property for their faith are reminded that no earthly city was ever permanent anyway.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But your iniquities have _____ between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.
verse: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.
note: God's arm isn't short nor his ear heavy (59:1); the problem is that 'your iniquities have separated' you from him.
